findings.text: follow-on: _review_owed_fields catches Exception and returns review_owed as an empty list when the coverage predicate raises, so a debt that cannot be measured reads as nothing owed and the author cannot tell it from the truth; narrowing the catch to the errors an unreadable plan raises and surfacing the unknown (a null plus the error) removes the fail-open.

justifications.reuse: the node reuses the one predicate — _review_coverage is renamed review_coverage and every caller updated rather than a second reader added beside it — and _review_owed_fields only formats its return, so no mechanism is duplicated.
